messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Hourly Calibration
parts:
Yes, you can
Format of the observed data is the same as daily, but instead the time step is just hourly. In addition, you need to change the source code to extract model output from each simulation in this file (https://github.com/tamnva/SWATshiny/blob/master/R/userReadSwatOutput.R). Can you provide the simulated data, I can have a look at this and let you know later
